Container.Name: nuvenna
Container.Overview: Nuvenna. Wiki with real-time editing, versions, comments, templates, ticket and query blocks. Open it through tvn-proxy, not directly: Tickvana and Nuvenna must share one address.

Config.Name: Public address
Config.Description: The address you open in the browser, without a trailing slash: the proxy, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080 or https://work.example.org. Same value in both apps.

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: At least 32 random characters, same in both apps. Never change it later (it encrypts stored passwords). Generate: openssl rand -base64 48

Config.Name: Database
Config.Description: postgres://… or mysql://… Replace PASSWORD with the database password.

Config.Name: Query engine database
Config.Description: Read-only role for SQL queries. Replace PASSWORD with the query role password. Leave empty to allow SQL for system administrators only.

Config.Name: Behind a proxy
Config.Description: Keep true: the app runs behind tvn-proxy.

Config.Name: Attachments
Config.Description: Same folder for Tickvana and Nuvenna.
